Before you come

Good to know

Cancellations

Let us know twelve hours ahead and there is no charge. The room is small, so a no-show costs us a whole table.

Allergies

Tell us when you book, not when you sit down. Almost everything can be adapted with a day's notice.

Children

Welcome at the Sunday lunch service. The evening room is quiet by design.

Parking

The old quarter is pedestrian after 19:00. The nearest garage is on Rua do Castelo, four minutes on foot.

Maison Noir

A candlelit twenty-eight seat dining room serving a seasonal modern European tasting menu in the heart of the old quarter.
